def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def concentric_rings(grid, box_color=5, fill_colors=(2,5), min_size=3):
    """Fill the inside of a rectangular box with concentric rings alternating through fill_colors, leaving any core of size min_size or smaller untouched."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if box_color in r]
    cols=[j for r in g for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==box_color]
    top,bot,left,right=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    k=0
    while (bot-top+1-2*k)>min_size and (right-left+1-2*k)>min_size:
        c=fill_colors[k%len(fill_colors)]
        for j in range(left+1+k, right-k):
            g[top+1+k][j]=c; g[bot-1-k][j]=c
        for i in range(top+1+k, bot-k):
            g[i][left+1+k]=c; g[i][right-1-k]=c
        k+=1
    return g

def concentric_rings(grid, box_color=5, fill_colors=(2,5), core=3):
    """Fill the inside of a rectangular box with concentric rings alternating through fill_colors, leaving an empty core of at least core x core."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if box_color in r]
    cols=[j for r in g for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==box_color]
    top,bot,left,right=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    k=0
    while (bot-top+1-2*k)>core+2 and (right-left+1-2*k)>core+2:
        c=fill_colors[k%len(fill_colors)]
        for j in range(left+1+k, right-k):
            g[top+1+k][j]=c; g[bot-1-k][j]=c
        for i in range(top+1+k, bot-k):
            g[i][left+1+k]=c; g[i][right-1-k]=c
        k+=1
    return g

def two_rings(grid, box_color=5, c1=2, c2=5):
    """Inside a rectangular box, draw one ring of c1 and one ring of c2; leave the core untouched."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if box_color in r]
    cols=[j for r in g for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==box_color]
    top,bot,left,right=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    for k,c in [(0,c1),(1,c2)]:
        t,b,l,r=top+1+k,bot-1-k,left+1+k,right-1-k
        if t>b or l>r: break
        for j in range(l,r+1): g[t][j]=c; g[b][j]=c
        for i in range(t,b+1): g[i][l]=c; g[i][r]=c
    return g

def layered_rings(grid, box_color=5, pat=PAT):
    """Inside a rectangular box, color concentric layers by distance d using pattern pat (0 = leave empty); a 2x2 layer is filled solid."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if box_color in r]
    cols=[j for r in g for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==box_color]
    top,bot,left,right=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)

    return g

def gridfrom(tx, tag):
    # extract grid after tag
    seg = tx.split(tag)[1]
    seg = seg.split("Same instance")[0].split("Test input")[0]
    rows=[]
    for line in seg.strip().splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        if not line or not line[0].isdigit(): 
            if rows: break
            continue
        rows.append([int(x) for x in line.split()])
    return rows

def ring_colors(out, box):
    # box: (r1,c1,r2,c2) of the 5-border
    r1,c1,r2,c2 = box
    H = r2-r1+1
    res=[]
    d=0
    while True:
        s = H-2*d
        if s<=0: break
        a=r1+d; b=c1+d
        if s==1:
            res.append((d+1, out[a][b]))
            break
        vals=set()
        for i in range(s):
            vals.add(out[a][b+i]); vals.add(out[a+s-1][b+i])
            vals.add(out[a+i][b]); vals.add(out[a+i][b+s-1])
        res.append((d+1, vals))
        if s<=2: break
        d+=1
    return res

import numpy as np
def rule(inp):
    a=np.array(inp); out=a.copy()
    nz=np.argwhere(a!=0); r0,c0=nz.min(0); r1,c1=nz.max(0)
    sub=a[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
    interior=sub[1:-1,1:-1]
    if (interior==0).all():  # hollow -> paint
        Pc=[5,2,5,0]; k=0; gaps=0
        R0,C0,R1,C1=r0,c0,r1,c1
        while R1-R0+1>2:
            col=Pc[k%4]; gaps+= (col==0)
            out[R0,R0:R1+1]=col; out[R1,R0:R1+1]=col
            out[R0:R1+1,C0]=col; out[R0:R1+1,C1]=col
            R0+=1;C0+=1;R1-=1;C1-=1;k+=1
        fill = 2 if gaps%2 else 5
        out[R0:R1+1,C0:C1+1]=fill
    return out

def rule(inp):
    a=np.array(inp); out=a.copy()
    nz=np.argwhere(a!=0); r0,c0=nz.min(0); r1,c1=nz.max(0)
    interior=a[r0+1:r1, c0+1:c1]
    if (interior==0).all():  # hollow -> paint rings
        Pc=[5,2,5,0]; k=0; gaps=0
        R0,C0,R1,C1=r0,c0,r1,c1
        while R1-R0+1>2:
            col=Pc[k%4]; gaps += (col==0)
            out[R0, C0:C1+1]=col; out[R1, C0:C1+1]=col
            out[R0:R1+1, C0]=col; out[R0:R1+1, C1]=col
            R0+=1;C0+=1;R1-=1;C1-=1;k+=1
        out[R0:R1+1, C0:C1+1] = 2 if gaps%2 else 5
    return out

def rule30(inp):
    g=[row[:] for row in inp]
    n=len(g); m=len(g[0])
    # find hollow/solid 5-box
    rs=[i for i in range(n) if any(v==5 for v in g[i])]
    cs=[j for j in range(m) if any(g[i][j]==5 for i in range(n))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    H=r1-r0+1; W=c1-c0+1
    if H!=W: return None
    pat=[5,2,5,0]
    k=0
    while H-2*k>2:
        col=pat[k%4]
        for j in range(c0+k,c1-k+1):
            g[r0+k][j]=col; g[r1-k][j]=col
        for i in range(r0+k+1,r1-k):
            g[i][c0+k]=col; g[i][c1-k]=col
        k+=1
    if H-2*k in (1,2):  # remnant block colored by continuing pattern
        col=pat[k%4]
        for i in range(r0+k,r1-k+1):
            for j in range(c0+k,c1-k+1):
                g[i][j]=col
    return g

def concentric_rings(grid, box_color=5, fill_colors=(2,5), core=3):
    """Fill the inside of a rectangular box with concentric rings alternating through fill_colors, leaving an empty core of at least core x core."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if box_color in r]
    cols=[j for r in g for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==box_color]
    top,bot,left,right=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    k=0
    while (bot-top+1-2*k)>core+2 and (right-left+1-2*k)>core+2:
        c=fill_colors[k%len(fill_colors)]
        for j in range(left+1+k, right-k):
            g[top+1+k][j]=c; g[bot-1-k][j]=c
        for i in range(top+1+k, bot-k):
            g[i][left+1+k]=c; g[i][right-1-k]=c
        k+=1
    return g

def fill_box_rings(grid, box_color=5, pattern=(5, 2, 5, 0)):
    """Fill the interior of a rectangular box of box_color with concentric square rings cycling through pattern (counted from the border); a leftover core of size <= 2 is painted with the next pattern color, a larger leftover core is left unchanged."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if box_color in r]
    cols=[j for r in g for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==box_color]
    top,bot,left,right=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    size=right-left+1
    k=0
    while size-2*k>=3:
        c=pattern[k%len(pattern)]
        for j in range(left+k,right-k+1):
            g[top+k][j]=c; g[bot-k][j]=c
        for i in range(top+k+1,bot-k):
            g[i][left+k]=c; g[i][right-k]=c
        k+=1
    if 0<size-2*k<=2:
        c=pattern[k%len(pattern)]
        for i in range(top+k,bot-k+1):

    return g

def fill_box_rings(grid, box_color=5, pattern=(5, 2, 5, 0)):
    """Fill the interior of a rectangular box of box_color with concentric square rings cycling through pattern (counted from the border); the innermost leftover block (1x1..3x3) is painted solid with the next pattern color."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if box_color in r]
    cols=[j for r in g for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==box_color]
    if not rows: return g
    top,bot,left,right=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    size=right-left+1
    k=0
    while size-2*k>=5:
        c=pattern[k%len(pattern)]

def fill_box_rings(grid, box_color=5, pattern=(5, 2, 5, 0), solid_core_sizes=(9,)):
    """Fill the interior of a rectangular box of box_color with concentric square rings cycling through pattern (counted from the border); the innermost leftover block (1x1..3x3) is painted solid with the next pattern color, except that boxes whose size is in solid_core_sizes get their innermost 3x3 filled solid."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if box_color in r]
    cols=[j for r in g for j,c in enumerate(r) if c==box_color]
    if not rows: return g
    top,bot,left,right=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    size=right-left+1
    k=0
    while size-2*k>3 or (size-2*k==3 and size not in solid_core_sizes):
        c=pattern[k%len(pattern)]
        for j in range(left+k,right-k+1):
            g[top+k][j]=c; g[bot-k][j]=c
        for i in range(top+k+1,bot-k):
            g[i][left+k]=c; g[i][right-k]=c
        k+=1
    c=pattern[k%len(pattern)]
    for i in range(top+k,bot-k+1):
        for j in range(left+k,right-k+1):
            g[i][j]=c
    return g
